content.rendered:
They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death. Three ingredients of the believer’s ultimate victory. Blood. Testimony. Surrender.

The Gospel For Today | Saturday, July 25, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.”
Revelation 12:11 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Revelation 12 is one of the most compressed spiritual-warfare passages in the New Testament. John, exiled on the island of Patmos, is shown a vision of the great red dragon, the accuser of the brothers and sisters, being thrown down from heaven. In the middle of the vision, a loud voice from heaven declares how the accuser has been overcome. Not by human strength. Not by clever argument. Not by moral effort. By three specific realities. The blood of the Lamb. The word of the believers’ testimony. And the willingness of the saints to lose their lives rather than deny their Lord.

Start with the first ingredient. The blood of the Lamb. This is the objective, cosmic reality that has already been established at the cross. The blood of Jesus is the legal and spiritual currency that defeats the accuser’s claim on the believer. When the enemy points to the believer’s failure and demands judgement, the answer from heaven is the blood. When the accuser reminds heaven of the believer’s past, the answer is the blood. The believer does not overcome by producing better behaviour. The believer overcomes by the finished, sufficient, all-atoning blood of the Lamb that was slain from the foundation of the world.

The second ingredient is the word of their testimony. The believer overcomes not just by what the blood has done for them, but by what they say about what the blood has done for them. The believer’s testimony is a spiritual weapon. Speaking out loud what Jesus has accomplished, what He has forgiven, what He has healed, what He has restored, what He has promised. The testimony is not merely a personal share. It is a spiritual declaration that agrees with heaven’s verdict on the believer’s life. The accuser cannot stand where the testimony is spoken because the testimony is the reminder that the blood has already answered every accusation.

The third ingredient, easily missed but critically important, is that the believers loved not their lives even unto death. They were not clinging to self-preservation. They had already surrendered the outcome of their lives to Christ. This is where earthly-minded believers get stuck. If the goal is to preserve one’s comfort at all costs, the accuser has leverage. If the goal has already been surrendered to Christ, and death itself is no longer feared, the accuser has nothing left to threaten with. The overcoming church throughout history has been the church that has already given its life away.

For Gospelbuzz readers, the truth this morning is uncompromising. The believer’s victory over the accuser rests on three anchors. The blood of Jesus, the spoken testimony of what He has done, and the settled heart that has already handed everything back to Him. When those three are in place, the accuser has nothing left. The victory is total. Walk in that today.

Prayer

Father, I acknowledge that I overcome the accuser by the blood of the Lamb, by the word of my testimony, and by the surrender of my life to You. The blood of Jesus has already answered every accusation against me. I speak that testimony out loud today. I declare what Jesus has done in my life. I refuse to hold my life back for my own preservation. I have already given it to You in Christ. The accuser has nothing left to threaten me with because I have already handed the outcome to You. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I overcome by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of my testimony. My life is already surrendered to Christ. The accuser has nothing left. The victory is total.
